plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): the official BSU 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog 'Major in Computer Science (BA/BS)' page for all major course codes, titles, and credits (Core 27 cr; Discrete + Statistics 6-8 cr; General CS concentration 27-28 cr). UCC (University Core Curriculum) structure per BSU Fall 2025 advising sheets and the 2015-16 UCC document: Foundations (ENG 103/104, COMM 210, MATH 125/132/161/165/181, HIST 150, PFW 2, FIN 101 1, WPP 392 0 cr), Tier 1 (one each Fine Arts, Humanities, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences), Tier 2 (one FA/Design/Humanities, one NS/SS), Tier 3 capstone (typically the major capstone; major-restricted). Up to 6 cr of major coursework may count toward the Core. Major: 27 (core) + 7 (MATH 215 + MATH 181) + 28 (General CS: 15 required + MATH 165 (4) + 9 CS electives) = 62 cr. UCC beyond major: 34 cr; free electives 24 cr; total 120. CS 495 (Fall) and CS 498 (Spring) are a single 2-semester immersive project taken in the same academic year. SEMESTER ARRANGEMENT IS A CONSTRUCTED SAMPLE SEQUENCE - BSU does not publish an official 4-year sequence for this major; an advisor should verify the sequence. Prerequisites are not encoded beyond natural course-numbering order; see the BSU catalog for official prerequisites.
